mapping_provenance.notes: All three direct anchors yield RAM-raw=0x4E70. The inferred spans lie inside one 1024-byte D88 payload sector without crossing a sector header. The direct analysis allocates D8C8~D941 as a contiguous reserved code pool. New bytes come from direct TEST9 RAM payload records; no editor payload/output bytes used.

lookup_reference.use: Encode each direct Unicode Korean display character to its current 558-map token; punctuation tokens use the documented fixed values. The source table serialized 0361 display-byte column is not used for new display bytes.

body_layout.main_table: Table 4: 545 execution records; Table 5: final body layout; Table 6: D88 raw payload offsets
body_layout.raw_mapping_basis: Explicit Table 6 physical D88 payload offsets; sector headers excluded. No linear mapping across the 0x08D90–0x08D9F sector header.

current_start_pointer.value_source: Derived little-endian from the current direct D982 body start in Tables 5–6. Historical 6/19 D9A6 state is superseded.

body_layout.row_byte_policy: For each 표시 row, take exactly one Unicode text cell and re-encode through the 558-character map or the documented special token map. Do not reuse the source table 0361 byte field. For non-display control/layout rows, use the direct Table 4 structural byte cell after length check.
body_layout.historical_note: Some Table 4 row notes repeat an earlier D9A6 relocation statement. Tables 5–6 state the final 2026-07-27 D982 body range and physical segments; this patch follows those final layout tables.
body_layout.runtime_state: The 2026-08-14 TEST9 evidence is from the original D974 script state. The combined execution of the relocated D982–DD68 body with all TEST9 hooks is not documented as a runtime test.

reviewed_noop_rows.reason: All 60 source records are non-display substream/runtime references outside the explicit relocated body through DD68. Their direct structural byte cells were checked against the original Japanese A at the original D974-based runtime mapping; all 29 unique spans match byte-for-byte and remain untouched by the body relocation.
